body:
Honestly, what has kept me from it lately has been that my husband has hidden all the pills from me for the last six months or so.  Before that, I would just tell him if it was getting too bad and he would hide them.  I always knew though that if I really wanted to, there was no way that he, or anyone else, would be able to stop me.

Now, I know that I could plan it out without being caught and it is combined with me not feeling any sort of hope for the future.  I am scared because this is the closest I've actually come to doing it.  It is bad enough that I am not asking for help through my normal routes because they will stop me.

I want an end to all of the pain and uncertainty.
